library_support.name: General GNU APL/PCRE2 literal global substitution binding
library_support.reason: Accepts arbitrary pattern/replacement/subject strings. The adapter invokes standard pcre2_substitute, handles output buffer capacity and converts Unicode strings. It has no benchmark patterns, no count loop, no benchmark sequence, no length-only shortcut, and no I/O.
library_support.memory_strategy: The large subject is the direct APL right argument. C++ stores Unicode subject/output buffers; it does not allocate whole-length APL integer masks, prefix arrays, destination arrays or a per-match container. Only complete replacement text is returned. Arbitrary expanding replacements retry after PCRE2 reports required capacity.

library_support.name: General GNU APL/PCRE2 literal global substitution binding
library_support.reason: Accepts arbitrary pattern/replacement/subject strings. The adapter invokes standard pcre2_substitute, handles output buffer capacity and converts Unicode strings. It has no benchmark patterns, no count loop, no benchmark sequence, no length-only shortcut, and no I/O.
library_support.memory_strategy: The large subject is the direct APL right argument. C++ stores Unicode subject/output buffers; it does not allocate whole-length APL integer masks, prefix arrays, destination arrays or a per-match container. Only complete replacement text is returned. Arbitrary expanding replacements retry after PCRE2 reports required capacity.

reason.diagnosis: GNU APL uses /proc/meminfo and falls back to approximately 3 GiB on macOS; WA_scale defaults to 90%. The previous nested subject argument and whole-length array temporaries exceed this logical workspace threshold.
reason.documented_mem_option: GNU APL --mem requires readable Linux /proc memory/overcommit controls and is unavailable on this macOS runtime.
reason.decision: Retain the unchanged runtime and safety guards. Remove application copies and whole-length APL replacement temporaries instead of increasing the memory limit. Full-size acceptance still requires the parent RSS/workspace guards and exact complete output.
reason.remaining_general_runtime_gap: A portable macOS available-memory estimator would remove the Linux-only fallback, but is not required or applied by these v2 sources.
